title: TelemetryHealth Pipeline Health
description: SigNoz native dashboard for real-time pipeline health, cardinality anomalies, orphaned spans, and AI agent token metrics

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT window_start AS time, 100 - (count() * 5) AS health_score FROM telemetry_health.cardinality_signal WHERE window_start >= NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

clickhouse_sql.name: B
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT window_start AS time, service, attribute_key, max(unique_estimate) AS cardinality FROM telemetry_health.cardinality_signal WHERE window_start >= NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY time, service, attribute_key ORDER BY time

clickhouse_sql.name: C
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfMinute(detected_at) AS time, count() AS orphan_count FROM telemetry_health.orphan_signal WHERE detected_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

clickhouse_sql.name: D
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfMinute(timestamp) AS time, service_name, avg(value) AS health_score FROM telemetry_health.metrics WHERE name = 'telemetryhealth_agent_health_score' AND timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY time, service_name ORDER BY time
